therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: PD-L1 checkpoint inhibition combined with stereotactic radiation to liver lesions
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Enhanced immune activation through radiation-induced abscopal effect combined with checkpoint blockade
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Extensive-stage small cell lung cancer patients

results.dose_information: Carboplatin AUC 5 mg/ml/min IV day 1 q21d x4 cycles; Etoposide 100 mg/m2 IV days 1-3 q21d x4 cycles; Atezolizumab 1200 mg IV day 1 q21d until progression; SBRT 10 Gy x3 doses on alternating days around cycle 2
